summary: Short 28 m kerb at a junction mouth under a No Stopping sign.
reasons: Short stretch at a road junction

drivers.seclusion: Houses about 15 m from the kerb at both ends and closing in around the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs round a junction bend on a narrow road; no room clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a junction at the bend.
drivers.convention: One car parked nearby, but the mapped sign forbids stopping.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shading most of the stretch.
